info.title: tack-RPC
info.description: tack-RPC v3: the host <-> plugin protocol for tack Level-3 plugins. JSON-RPC 2.0 envelopes over NDJSON stdio (process carrier) or WIT component calls (WASM carrier). This document is the single source of truth; Rust types in crates/tack-ext/src/rpc3.rs are generated from it by `cargo run -p xtask -- codegen`. Method naming follows MCP conventions (<namespace>/<verb>); direction is annotated with x-direction. Design: docs/plugin-roadmap.md.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Lifecycle handshake, host -> plugin, sent immediately after spawn. The host advertises its capabilities and the validated per-plugin config; the plugin answers with its identity and its (all-optional) capability contributions. A protocolVersion outside the host's supported range is a clean handshake error, not a silent degradation.

methods.name: shutdown
methods.description: Graceful stop, host -> plugin. The plugin should finish in-flight work and exit; the host kills the carrier after a grace period.

methods.name: tools/execute
methods.description: Run a plugin-contributed tool. The call carries the provider-issued toolCallId so the plugin can correlate progress/cancellation.

methods.name: commands/invoke
methods.description: Run a plugin-registered slash command.

methods.name: hooks/beforeToolCall
methods.description: A tool call is about to run; the plugin may allow, deny (reason becomes the error tool result), or rewrite the arguments. Chained plugins observe the previous plugin's rewrite; the first deny short-circuits.

methods.name: hooks/transformContext
methods.description: COW context pipeline (opt-in via capabilities.hooks.transformContext): a null result means unchanged; a returned {messages: [...]} object replaces the messages every later hook sees.

methods.name: hooks/afterToolCall
methods.description: Observe and patch a tool result (opt-in via capabilities.hooks.afterToolCall). Patches merge in chain order; later plugins win per field.

methods.name: approval/review
methods.description: An approval decision is needed (opt-in via capabilities.hooks.approvalReview). A null result passes to the next reviewer in the chain; a returned decision claims the approval (first-claim-wins).

methods.name: autocomplete/provide
methods.description: Query an autocomplete provider for input-line suggestions. Timeouts and cancellations degrade to no suggestions.

methods.name: events/lifecycle
methods.description: Lifecycle notification, subscription-gated via capabilities.events. The event name is one of the well-known lifecycle set (sessionStart, sessionShutdown, agentStart, agentEnd, turnStart, turnEnd, messageStart, messageEnd, toolExecutionStart, toolExecutionEnd, modelSelect, thinkingLevelSelect); the payload shape depends on the event.

methods.name: widgets/action
methods.description: User interaction with a declared widget (never produced in headless modes). Sent only to the owning plugin.

methods.name: provider/stream
methods.description: Start one inference stream on a bridge provider (capability provider.stream). The answer is a fast ack: synchronous validation only (capability granted, params shape); the turn's events then flow as plugin->host provider/streamEvent notifications demuxed by streamId, ending with exactly one terminal event (done/error).

methods.name: provider/streamCancel
methods.description: Abort an in-flight inference stream (host cancelled / user pressed Esc). The plugin should end the stream promptly with its own terminal event; the host synthesizes a terminal error after a grace period if it does not.

methods.name: widgets/update
methods.description: Idempotent full-state replacement for a declared widget (not a diff; dropped frames are harmless).

methods.name: session/get
methods.description: Read current session state (trust/mode gated).

methods.name: session/sendUserMessage
methods.description: Inject a user message into the session (trust/mode gated).

methods.name: snapshot/get
methods.description: Versioned read-only session digest. historyVersion and compactionRevision let the plugin detect staleness between calls without re-fetching.

methods.name: config/get
methods.description: Read the plugin's effective configuration (host-validated against the declared config schema; invalid user config degrades to defaults with a load warning).

methods.name: ui/notify
methods.description: Show a notification. Headless modes degrade to a log line.

methods.name: ui/select
methods.description: Ask the user to pick one option. Headless modes answer with an error (see host capabilities). A null result means dismissed.

methods.name: ui/confirm
methods.description: Ask the user for confirmation. Headless modes answer with an error.

methods.name: ui/input
methods.description: Prompt the user for free text. A null result means cancelled; headless modes answer with an error.

methods.name: exec/run
methods.description: Run a shell command on the host. Trust-gated: untrusted contexts answer with a policyDenied error.

methods.name: logs/emit
methods.description: Diagnostic log line, routed to the host log with plugin attribution.

methods.name: warnings/emit
methods.description: Structured user-facing warning (dismissible in the TUI, logged with plugin attribution everywhere).

methods.name: provider/streamEvent
methods.description: One AssistantMessageEvent per notification (provider-shaped JSON), demuxed by streamId. Exactly one terminal event (done/error) ends the stream; events after the terminal are a protocol violation.

methods.name: provider/event
methods.description: Provider-scoped out-of-band event from a bridge provider: rate limits, warnings, info. Surfaced like the native rate-limit path (inline warning + desktop notification in the TUI, log line in headless modes).

methods.name: host/registerProvider
methods.description: Dynamically register an LLM provider (trust/mode gated). The registration payload mirrors the provider registry entry format; with bridge: true the plugin serves inference itself via provider/stream (capability provider.stream) and every model is assigned the reserved api kind ext-provider-bridge (baseUrl/apiKey/headers are ignored).

RunMode.description: Host run mode, reported at initialize so a plugin never depends on interactive requests for correctness.

HostInfo.description: Host identification (for user agents and logs).

MetricsHostCapability.description: Metrics sidecar host support: the plugin appends NDJSON measurements to scratchFile; the host validates the drain against the declared operations schema.

scratchFile.description: Absolute path of the per-session scratch file (WASM carrier: inside the dedicated preopen).

HostCapabilities.description: What this host supports in the current mode. Absent boolean means unsupported; a plugin must check before depending on a surface.

protocolVersion.description: Semver protocol version the host speaks.

trusted.description: Project trust state; gates exec and other privileged services.

config.description: Effective per-plugin configuration, validated against the plugin's declared config schema (empty object when the plugin declares none).

ToolSpec.description: A contributed tool. parameters must be a JSON object schema; anything else is rejected at registration.

parameters.description: JSON Schema (object) of the tool arguments.

HookCapabilities.description: Opt-in hook surfaces. Absent boolean means not implemented (the host skips the call entirely).

WidgetKind.description: Declarative widget kinds; the host owns rendering and layout.

WidgetSpec.description: A declared long-lived UI unit. The host keys it as <plugin>:<id>; the plugin pushes full-state snapshots via widgets/update.

priority.description: Sort key for status line segments (smaller first).

title.description: Panel title (required by contract for panel kinds).

initial.description: Initial state, shaped per the widget kind.

AutocompleteProviderSpec.description: An autocomplete provider for the input line.

trigger.description: Token prefix that triggers the provider (for example #).

StatusLineState.description: State of a statusLineSegment widget (widget initial state and widgets/update state for that kind). Empty text hides the segment; the host truncates to one line.

MarkdownPanelState.description: State of a markdownPanel widget: markdown source rendered with the host's markdown pipeline.

ListPanelItem.description: One item in a listPanel widget.

ListPanelState.description: State of a listPanel widget. The host renders the selection; a user pick is reported back as widgets/action with action select.

ConfigDeclaration.description: Per-plugin configuration declaration: a JSON Schema the host validates settings plugins."<id>".config against at load time.

schema.description: JSON Schema (object) of the plugin configuration.

MetricOperation.description: One declared metric operation. Identifiers match [a-z][a-z0-9_.]{0,63}; at most 8 dimensions per operation.

MetricsDeclaration.description: Declared telemetry schema for the metrics sidecar. Any violation voids the whole declaration with a load warning.

PluginCapabilities.description: Everything a plugin contributes. Every field is optional and independent; an absent field contributes nothing and costs nothing.

events.description: Lifecycle events the plugin subscribes to (empty/absent = the default set).

arguments.description: Validated against the tool's parameter schema by the host.

ContentBlock.description: One tool output content block. Fields not matching kind are absent (text blocks carry text; image blocks carry mimeType + data).

details.description: Structured details for the UI (not sent to the model).

assistantMessage.description: The assistant message that issued the call (provider-shaped JSON).

Verdict.description: Interception verdict. deny carries reason (becomes the error tool result); rewrite carries arguments (the full replacement).

TransformContextParams.description: hooks/transformContext params. Messages are session-entry shaped JSON.

TransformContextResult.description: null = unchanged; a returned {messages: [...]} object replaces the context every later hook (and the loop) sees.

AfterToolCallPatch.description: Per-field patch; absent fields are untouched. Later plugins in the chain win per field.

terminate.description: End the agent loop after this result.

approvalPolicy.description: The session's active approval policy name.

evidence.description: Permission evidence gathered by the host (rule matches, sandbox state).

ApprovalDecisionAction.description: Approval outcomes a reviewer can return.

ApprovalDecision.description: A claimed approval decision (a null method result passes to the next reviewer).

AutocompleteSuggestion.description: One suggestion. insertText absent = insert value.

AutocompleteProvideResult.description: An empty suggestions list is a legal no-suggestions answer.

LifecycleEventParams.description: events/lifecycle params. event is the lifecycle event name; payload is event-shaped JSON.

WidgetUpdateParams.description: widgets/update params: idempotent full-state replacement, shaped per the widget kind.

WidgetActionParams.description: widgets/action params (for example action select for list panels).

Snapshot.description: snapshot/get result: a digest, not a transcript (full-history use cases are served by event subscriptions).

recentDigest.description: Truncated, prompt-hygiene-normalized digest of recent messages.

config.description: Effective per-plugin config (host-validated; defaults when the user config was invalid).

context.description: Structured context shown in the warning details.

ProviderCapability.description: Provider surface: `register` — the plugin calls host/registerProvider with plain (non-bridge) specs; `stream` — the plugin additionally serves inference for the providers it registers (host/registerProvider with bridge: true) through provider/stream.

register.description: The plugin calls host/registerProvider with plain (non-bridge) specs.

ProviderStreamParams.description: provider/stream params: start one inference stream on a bridge provider.

streamId.description: Host-generated stream id, unique per connection.

model.description: The resolved registry Model entry (provider-shaped JSON).

context.description: The full session Context: system prompt, messages, tools (provider-shaped JSON).

options.description: Serializable subset of the host stream options: maxTokens, temperature, reasoning, thinkingBudgets, toolChoice, cacheRetention, sessionId, headers, samplingParams. Bridge providers manage their own credentials (no apiKey is sent); cancellation rides provider/streamCancel and retry policy belongs to the plugin.

event.description: One AssistantMessageEvent (provider-shaped JSON, type-tagged: start, textStart/textDelta/textEnd, thinkingStart/thinkingDelta/thinkingEnd, toolCallStart/toolCallDelta/toolCallEnd, done, error; done/error are terminal).

RegisterProviderParams.description: host/registerProvider params: a provider registry entry (provider-shaped JSON).
